newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian gold ends flat, silver loses early gains.
newsitem.headline: Indian gold ends flat, silver loses early gains.

text.p: Gold recovered on speculative buying on reports of recovery in the world market after opening weak on Wednesday as festival demand petered out, dealers said.
"Physical buying was low today and most of the trading was of a speculative nature," a dealer said.
Gold biscuits (116.50 gramme) settled 100 rupees higher at 60,300 rupees per piece. They were up by 100 rupees per piece during last week.
Silver opened higher on a shortage of ready stock but demand resistance trimmed early gains towards the close, dealers said.
